title: עֲבַד
content:
[Str5648,5647] עֲבַד vb. make, do (Targum Syr. OAram. Nab. Palm. Eg. Aram. (S-CPap.; cf. אַזְדָּא); = BH עָבַד, q.v., but in mng. ‖עשה);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´ע: Dn 3:1 +, 2 ms. עֲבַָדְתְּ (K§ 13, 2) 4:32; 1 s. עַבְדֵַת 3:15, 6:23, 3 mpl. עֲבַ֫דוּ Ezr 6:13 +; Impf. 2 mpl. תַּעְבְּדוּן (Baer K§ 38. 1. b); תַּעַבְדוּן Gi Str) Ezr 6:8, 7:18; Inf. מֶעְבַּד (K§ 15, a) 2)) 4:22, 7:18 (מֶעְבַָּד); Pt. act. עָבֵד 7:26 +, fs. עָֽבְדָא Dn 7:21; mpl. עָֽבְדִין Ezr 4:15;—1. make, acc. rei Dn 3:1; 3:15 and (of creation) Je 10:11; make a feast Dn 5:1, war 7:21 (עם Pers.). ded. of temple Ezr 6:16. 2. do, acc. of deed, Dn 4:32 (of God), 6:23 Ezr 4:15, 4:22; do, act, כְּנֵמָא, thus, Ezr 6:13, כ, according to, Dn 7:18 and (of God) 4:32, abs. 6:11; acc. +ב rei Ezr 7:18 do something with, +עִם Pers. 6:8; do, perform, acc. of God’s law 7:26, acc. of signs, etc. (subj. God) Dn 6:28 and (+עִם Pers.) 3:32. Hithpe. Impf. 3 ms. יִתְעֲבֵד Ezr 6:11 +, דִָ֯ 6:12, 7:21; 2 mpl. תִּתְעַבְדוּן Dn 2:5; Pt. מִתְעֲבֵד Ezr 7:26, בֶ־ד- 4:19, fs. עַבְדָא- 5:3;—1. be made into, c. n. pred., Dn 2:5, 3:29, Ezr 6:11. 2. be done, wrought, 4:19, 5:8 (subj. עֲבִידְתָּא); be performed, executed, of command Ezr 6:12, 7:21, 7:23, judgment 7:26.

[Str5649,5650] † [עֲבַד Dp. 105, or עֲבֵד K§ 54, 3. γ)] n.m. slave, servant (BH עֶ֫בֶד);—cstr. עֲבֵד Dn 6:21 servant of God; pl. sf. of king, עבדיך Kt (K§ 53 Anm. b)), עַבְדָּךְ Qr Ezr 4:11, עַבְדָךְ Qr Dn 2:4; sf. of God, עַבְד֫וֺתִי, Dn 3:26, 3:28, Ezr 5:11, of king Dn 2:7.

[Str5665,5664] † עֲבֵד נְגוֺ n.pr.m. comrade of Daniel (BH id.);—Dn 2:49, 3:12 + 10 t. 3, +עֲבֵד נְגוֺא 3:29; = עֲזַרְיָה 2:17.

[Str5656,5673] † [עֲבִידָה] n.f. work, service (BH עֲבֹדָה);—emph. עֲבִידְתָּא Ezr 5:8, Dn 2:49, cstr. עֲבִידַת Ezr 4:24 +;—1. work, of building temple, Ezr 4:24, 5:8, 6:7; = administration Dn 2:49, 3:12. 2. ritual, service, of God Ezr 6:18.

[Str4567,4566] † [מַעֲבַד K§ 60, 3) b)] n.[m.] work (BH [מַעְבָּד] † Jb 34:25; †Targumib.; Syr. ܡܥܒܕ of magic works);—pl. sf. מַעֲבָדוֺ֫הִי Dn 4:34 (sf. of God).

[Str5675,5676] † עֲבַר n.m. region across, beyond (v. BH 1. עֵ֫בֶר √עָבַר);—cstr. in phr. נַהֲרָה(־)עֲבַר, i.e. Syria (Scheft87): Ezr 4:10, 4:11, 4:17, 4:20, 5:3, 5:6, 5:6, 6:6, 6:6, 6:8, 6:13, 7:21, 7:25, נהרא ´ע: 4:16. Cf. in Cilic. Aram., Cooke346.

title: עַד
content: [Str5705] עַד v. עדה. below

title: עֲדָה
content: [Str5709,5674,5710] † [עֲדָה] vb. pass on, away (Targum (oft. for Heb. עָבַר, Syr.; v. BH I. עָדָה (rare, late));—Pe. Pf. 3 fs. עֲדָת Dn 3:27, 4:28; Impf. 3 ms. יֶעְדֵּה 7:14, 3 fs. תֶּעְדֵּה 6:9;—1. pass on, over, c. ב Pers. Dn 3:27. 2. pass way, of kingdom 4:28 (מִן Pers.), 7:14; of law 6:9. Haph. take away (so Eg. Aram. S-CG 35): Pf. 3 mpl. הֶעְדִּיו, acc. rei, Dn 5:20 (מִן Pers.), 7:12; Impf. 3 mpl. יְהַעְדּוּן v:26; Pt. מְהַעְדֵּה 2:21 remove, depose kings, of God.

title: עַד
content:
[Str5705,5704] † עַד:35 prep. and conj. even to, until (BH III. עַד; so Targum Syr. OAram. Nab. Palm. Eg. Aram. (Lzb336 S-CA 5 +));—1. prep.: a. of space, even to Dn 7:13; עַד־כָּא v:28. b. of amount, up to Ezr 7:22 (4 t.). c. of time, until Dn 2:20, 6:15, 6:27, 7:18, 7:18, 7:26, Ezr 4:24, 5:16 וְעַד־כְּעַן; = our against 6:15 (cf. BH, p. 724:a top); to (the end of) = during Dn 6:8 עַד יוֺמִין תְּלָתִין, v:13, 7:12, 7:25. On עַד־אָחֳרָן Dn 4:5 v. אָחֳרָן; and on עַד־דִּבְרַת דִּי 4:14 v. [דִּבְרָה]. 2. conj.: a. עַד־דִּי until, sq. pf. (of past time) Dn 2:34, 4:30, 5:21, 7:4, 7:9, 7:11, 7:22; sq. impf. (of fut.) 2:9, 4:20, 4:22, 4:22, 4:29.—Dn 6:25 ´עַד דִּי שְׁלִטוּ וג…לָא מְטוֺ:: up to the time that … , i.e. ere that. b. עַד alone, Ezr 4:21, 5:5.

[Str5732] † עִדָּן n.m.:Dn 2:9 time (Targum id., Syr. ܥܕܢܐ, perh. loan-word from As. adannu, fixed, appointed, or definite, time; [Ar. عدّان prob. Aram. loan-wd., SchwallyZMG liii (1899), 197]);—abs. ´ע: Dn 7:12 +; emph. עִדָּנָא 2:8 +; pl. abs. עִדָּנִין 4:13 +, emph. עִדָּנַיָּא 2:21;—1. in gen., time, as duration Dn 2:8, 7:12; involving specif. conditions 2:9, 2:21; (point of) time 3:5, 3:15. 2. definite time, = year (as mod. Gk. ξρόνος, v. EASophocles1173): ´שִׁבְעָה ע: = seven years, 4:13, 4:20, 4:22, 4:29; עִדָּן וְעִדָּנִין וּפְלַג עִדָּן 7:25 (i.e. 3 1/2 years, v. Dr; perhaps read du. for pl., cf. Bev GunkSchöpf. 201).

title: עוֺד
content:
[Str5750–51] † עוֺד adv. still (BH; S-CK 13; TargumO Jon.; Chr-Pal. Schulth143 f.), Dn 4:28 עוֺד מִלְּתָא בְּפֻם מַלְכָּא (cf. BH 1 a a).

[Str5753,5758,5771] † [עֲוָיָה] n.f. iniquity (BH II. עוה, עָוֺן; cf. Targum עֲוָיָא);—pl. sf. עֲוָיָתָךְ (K§ 56 a)β)2) Dn 4:24.

[Str5774,5776] † עוֺף n.[m.] fowl (v. BH, √I. עוּף);—´ע: abs. Dn 7:6 wings of a fowl; cstr. 2:38 coll.

[Str5784] † עוּר n.[m.] chaff (J Aram. (Talm., rare), Syr. ܥܘܪܐ; Ar. عُوَّارٌ, عَايءِرٌ mote (in eye, tending to cause blindness [עִוֵּר]) acc. to Ar. Lexx., Lane2195);—abs. ´ע: Dn 2:35 (in sim.).

[Str5796] [עֵז], עִזִּין v. ענז

[Str5824,5823] † [עִזְקָה] n.f. signet-ring (Targum Syr.; √ עזק = surroung, v. BH);—sf. עִזְקְתֵהּ Dn 6:18; pl. cstr. קָת- v:18.

[Str5830–31] † עֶזְרָא n.pr.m Ezra (BH id.);—Ezr 7:12, 7:21, 7:25.

[Str5838–39] † עְזַרְיָה n.pr.m. comrade of Daniel (BH id.; Dn 1:6 +);—Dn 2:17, = עֲבֵד נְגוֺ v:49 +.

[Str5843] עֵטָא v. יעט. p. 1096

[Str5869–70] † [עַ֫יִן] n.f.:Ezr 5:5 eye (v. BH I. ´ע:);—cstr. עֵין Ezr 5:5 (of God); pl. (K§ 51, 1) of horn, עַיְנִין Dn 7:8, 7:20; of man, du. cstr. עַיְנֵי v:8, sf עַיְנַי 4:31.

[Str5894,5782] † עִיר n.m. waking, or wakeful, one, i.e. angel (√עיר, cf. Syr. ܥܳܪ wake, ܥܝܪ waking (PS2843), JAram. עִיר, NH עֵיר adj. awake);—abs. ´ע: Dn 4:10, 4:20; pl. abs. עִירִין v:14; Aq Symm. ἐγρήγορος; cf. CharlesEnoch i. 5; xxxix. 12; also p. 356 Drad loc.; doubtful is the connex. with Ph. Zophesemim (Euseb.:Praep. Evang. 10), i.e. צפי שמים watchers of heaven, as keeping watch over or spying out (ZimKAT 3. 629 JeremAtim Licht d. AO 63).

[Str5922,5924,5931] עַל, עֵלָּא v. עלה. עִלָּה v. I. עלל

title: עלה
content:
[Str5927] עלה (√of foll.; v. BH עָלָה).

[Str5928] † [עֲלָת K§ 56, α) β) 2] n.f. burnt-offering (BH עוֺלָה; cf. Palm. עלתא altar, SAC92 Lzb341);—pl. abs. עֲלָוָן Ezr 6:9.

[Str5943] † [עִלָּי K§ 59 1) e)] adj. highest;—alw. emph. עליא Kt, עִלָּאָה Qr, the Most High God: ´אֱלָהָא ע: Dn 3:26, 3:32, 5:18, 5:21; ´ע: alone, the Most High, 4:14, 4:21, 4:22, 4:29, 4:31, 7:25 (cf. Nab. n.pr. עליאל Lzb341 SAC91).

[Str5945–46] ‡ † [עֶלְיוֺן] adj. id. (BH id.);—pl. of God, קַדִּישֵׁי עֶלְיוֺנִין (double pl., Buhl, as sts. BH, Ges§ 124 q Köii. 1. 438 f) Dn 7:18, 7:22, 7:25, 7:27.

[Str5952,5944] † [עֲלִי] n.f. roof-chamber (cf. Dr; BH עֲלִיָּה);—sf. עֲלִיתֵהּ Dn 6:11.

title: עַל
content:
[Str5922,5921] עַל prep. upon, over, on account of, above, to, against (BH and general Aram. id.);—sf. 1 s. עֲלַי; 2 ms. עליך Kt (so Eg. Aram., CookeNo. 77, A 5, 6, B 8, S-CPap. A 3, B 5+), עֲלָךְ, Qr (Targum עֲלַךְ, Dalm:§ 47, 2) Dn 3:12 + 6 t. Dn, Ezr 7:18; 3 ms. עֲלוֺהִי (so Nab. Palm.; Eg. Aram. עלוי S-CA 6 +) Dn 3:28 +, עֲלֽהִי † Ezr 6:11; 3 fs. עליה Kt (so Eg. Aram., S-CD 24), עֲלַהּ Qr (so Targum) †Dn 4:14, 5:21; 1 pl. עֲלֵינָא † Ezr 4:12, עֲלֵָינָא 4:18, 5:17 Baer (Gi עֲלֶָינָא); 3 mpl. עֲלֵיהֹם (so Nab., CISii. 226; Eg. Aram., S-CPap. F 5, 8+) † 7:24, עֲלֵיהוֺן † 5:1, 5:3;—1. a. upon, Dn 2:10, 2:28, 2:46, 5:5, 5:7, 6:11 + oft., 4:26 עַל־הֵיכַל מַלְכוּתָא (2 S 11:2); to be established עַל מַלְכוּתִי 4:33 (cf. 2 Ch 1:1; BH II. 1) to lay an impost upon, Ezr 7:24; to trust on, Dn 3:28; after a vb. of motion, מְטָא עַל to come upon, Dn 4:21, 4:25; of times, to pass over, 4:13, 4:20, 4:22, 4:29; Ezr 5:1 בְּשֻׁם אֱלָהּ יִשְרָאֵל עֲלֵיהוֺן i.e. (named) over them. b. idiom. (as in BH; v. II. 1 d) of the Pers. who is the subj. of an emotion or experience, Dn 5:9 וְזִיוֺתִי שָׁנַיִן עֲלוֺהִי were changed upon him, 7:28, 6:19 וְשִׁנְּתֵהּ נַדַּת עֲלוֺהִי (cf. 2:1). c. on acc. of (BH 1 f b), Dn 3:16 פִּתְגָּםעַל־דְּנָה. So in עַל־דְּנָה on this acc. †Ezr 4:15, 4:22, 5:17, עַל־מָה wherefore ? † Dn 2:15; and עַל דִּבְרַת דִּי (v. ´דְּ:). d. on behalf of (ib. 1 f c), Ezr 6:17. e. regarding, concerning (ib. 1 f g), Dn 2:18, 5:14, 5:29, 6:6, 6:13, Ezr 7:14 + oft. 2. over, with vbs. of ruling, appointing, etc., Dn 2:48, 2:49, 3:12, 4:14 +, Ezr 4:20, 6:18. 3. in a compar. sense, above, beyond, Dn 3:19, 6:4. 4. expressing direction: a. to, of a person, after a vb. of motion (cf. BH 7 c a a), Dn 2:24, 4:31, 4:33, 6:7, 6:16, Ezr 4:12, 4:23 + oft.; after to send (a letter, etc.) Ezr 4:11, 4:17, 4:18, 5:6 +, write 4:7, prophesy 5:1; of the direction of the mind (ib. 7c c), Dn 3:12, 6:14, 6:14, 6:15; cf. Ezr 5:5 הֲוַת עַל ´וְעֵין אֱל: (cf. Je 40:4 and אֶל Psalm 34:16). b. against, Dn 3:19, 3:29, 5:23, 6:5, 6:6 +; Ezr 4:8, 7:23. 5. in such phrases as שְׁפַר עַל, טְאֵב (to be) good or acceptable to (as in Syr. and late Heb.: v. BH 8), Ezr 5:17 אִם עַל מַלְכָּא טָב, 7:18, 7:18, Dn 4:24 (יִשְׁפַּר), 6:15 (בְּאֵשׁ), v:24 (טְאֵב).—Comp. the synopsis of meanings in Lzb340.

[Str5924] † עֵ֫לָּא adv.above (from n. עֵל, with א- of direction, D§ 44. 1 n.; Nab., Eg. Aram., id., Lzb341 S-CA 5+; Targum עֵיל, עֵילָא; Syr. ܥܠ in ܠܥܠ above);—Dn 6:3 עֵ֫לָּא מִנְּהוֺן above (over) them (cf. Cooke96. 2, Dt 28:43 Targum).

[Str5931,5953] † עִלָּה n.f. matter, affair, occasion (Syr. ܥܠܬܐ, v. BH I. עלל);—abs. ´ע: Dn 6:5, 6:5, 6:6 ( = ground of accusation).

title: עֲלַל
content:
[Str5954,5953] † [עֲלַל] vb. go or come in (Targum Syr.; v. BH III. עלל);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. עַל Dn 2:16; c. עַל Pers. v:24; c. לְבַיְהֵתּ 6:11, so 3 fs. עללת Kt, עַלַּת Qr 5:10; Pt. עללין Kt, עָלִּין Qr, abs. 4:4, 5:8. Haph. bring in, c. קֳדָם Pers.: Pf. 3 ms. הַנְעֵל (K§ 11, 4. b); si Eg, Aram., S-CG 6, 7, 24, 27 הנעלת; cf. D§ 71. 7; Dial.-Proben, p. 4); Dn 2:25 (ל acc. Pers.), 6:19 (acc. rei); Imv. ms. sf. Pers., הַעֵלְנִי 2:24; Inf. לְנְעָלָה 4:3 (ל acc. Pers.); no קֳדָם Pers., לְהֶעָלָה 5:7 (id.). Hoph. (WCG 225) be brought, subj. Pers. +קֳדָם Pers.: Pf. 3 ms. הֻעַל Dn 5:13, 3 mpl. הֻעַ֫לּוּ v:15.

[Str4606] † [מֶעָל] n.[m.] going in (Syr., TargumJ; TargumOnk, etc., מַעֲלָנָא);—pl. cstr. מֶעָלֵי שִׁמְשָׁא Dn 6:15 i.e. sunset (so read NöGGA, 1884, 1020 Str M Bev, cf. Syr. ܡܥܠ, ܡܥܠܝ; > van d. H. Gi מֵעָלֵי, Baer מַעֲלֵי; cf. K§, Beisp. b)).

[Str5957,5769] † עָלַם n.[m.] perpetuity, antiquity (v. BH III. עלם, עוֺלָם);—´ע: abs. Dn 3:33 +, cstr. 7:18; emph. עָֽלְמָא 2:20 +; pl. עָֽלְמִין 2:4 +, emph. עָֽלְמַיָּא 2:44, 7:18;—perpetuity in the future: ´מַלְכוּת ע: Dn 3:33, 7:27, cf. 4:31, 7:14; ´ע: as adv. for ever 4:31; עַד־עָֽלְמָא וְעַד־עָלַם עָֽלְמַיָּא 7:18; pl. ´לְע: for ever 2:4, 2:44, 2:44, 3:9, 5:10, 6:7, 6:22, 6:27; antiquity, מִן־יוֺמָת עָֽלְמָא Ezr 4:15, 4:19; of limitless time both past and future: ´וְעַד־ע :´מִן־ע: Dn 2:20.

[Str5962,5867] † עֵלְמָיֵא n.gent.pl. Elamites (cf. BH עֵילָם);—Ezr 4:9.

[Str5967,6763] † [עֲלַע] n.f. rib (Targum Syr.; v. BH I. צלע, צֵלָע);—pl. abs. עִלְעִין Dn 7:5.

[Str5928] [עֲלָת] v. עלה. above

[Str5971–72] † עַם n.m.:Ezr 6:12 people (v. BH I. עמם, עַם);—´ע: abs. Dn 2:44, 3:29, Ezr 6:12, cstr. Dn 7:27; emph. עַמָּה Ezr 5:12, עַמָּא 7:13, 7:16, 7:25; pl. emph. עַמֲמַיָּא (K§§ 15d); 55, 5 a)) Dn 3:4, 3:7, 3:7, 3:31, 5:19, 6:26, 7:14.

title: עִם
content:
[Str5973–74] עִם:22 prep. with (BH עִם: so Targum Syr. (ܥܡ) and general Aram.);—sf. עִמִּי † Dn 3:32, עִמָּךְ †Ezr 7:13, עִמֵהּ † Dn 2:22, עִמְּהוֺן † Ezr 5:2;—1. a. together with, Dn 2:18, 2:43, 7:13 עִם־עֲנָנֵי שְׁמַיָּא, Ezr 5:2 +; whose dwelling, portion, etc., is with Dn 2:11, 2:22, 4:12, 5:21. b. to speak with Dn 6:22, to make war with 7:21; to do with ( = towards) 3:32 דִּי עֲבַד עִמִּי (cf. Psalm 86:17), cf. Ezr 6:8; שַׁוִּי עִם to make like to Dn 6:21. † 2. of time, Dn 3:33 = 4:31 עִם־דָּר וְדָר (co-exists) with all generations (cf. BH 1 g); 7:2 עִם־לֵילְיָא during the night.

[Str5994,6012] † [עֲמִיק] adj. (v. BH עמק);—fpl. emph., as n., עֲמִיקָתָא Dn2:22 the deep things.

[Str6015,6785] † עֲמַר n.m. wool (Targum Syr.; Eg. Aram. עמר S-CG7, 10, קמר Id.:H 5; cf. Mand. אקאמרא, NöM 72; v. BH צמר);—abs. Dn 7:9.

title: I עֲנָה
content:
[Str6030,6032] † I. [עֲנָה] vb. answer (v. BH I. עָנָה);—Pe. Pf. 3 fs. עֲנַת Dn 5:10; 3 mpl. עֲנוֺ 2:7 +; Pt. act. (עֲנָה NöGGA, 1884, 1021) עָנֵה 2:5 +, pl. עָנַיִן (K§ 47 Beisp. e)) 3:24;—alw. + אמר Pt., answered and said (ל [or קֳדָם] Pers. usu. foll. אדר; foll. ´ע: 2:10, 2:27, 2:47):—1. answer, make reply, to something said: Dn 2:5, 2:7, 2:8, 2:10, 2:27, 3:16, 3:24, 3:25, 4:16 b, 5:17, 6:13, 6:14. 2. respond to occasion, speak in view of a situation: 2:15, 2:20, 2:26, 3:9, 3:14, 3:19, 3:24, 3:26, 3:28, 4:16 a, 4:27, 5:10.

[Str3705,6526,6528] † כְּעַן adv. now (so Eg. Aram. (CISii. 137 = CookeNo.73 RÉS361 B S-CPap. C 5); Targum, e.g. Nu 22:4: עַן prob. a subst. fr. [עָנָה] the √ of עֵת (p. 773:a), time; so כְּעַן lit. at (this) time = Heb. עַתָּה: K§ 67, 4);—Dn 2:23 וּכְעַן הוֺדַעְתַּנִי, 3:15, 4:34, 5:12, 5:15, 5:16, 6:9, Ezr 4:13, 4:14, 4:21, 5:17, 6:6; עַד־כְּעַן until now Ezr 5:16 (so Targum Gn 18:22 +).

[Str3706,3705] † כְּעֶ֫נֶת and (Ezr 4:17) contr. כְּעֶת adv. now (f. of כְּעַן; so first SS TorreyJBL 16 (1897), 166 ff.; now confirmed by Eg. Aram. כענת CowleyPSBA xxv. 264, 311, 312 ( =RES 492–4 = S-CM, N, O); ´וכ: formerly taken to mean and so forth);—alw. ´וּכ:, and alw. in a letter, introducing the business of the letter, and to be connected with what follows, not, as MT, with what precedes: Ezr 4:10 (del., as introduced by error from end of v:11), v:11 (joining to v:12) and now, let it be known, etc., v:17 f. and now, the letter which, etc., 7:12 f. and now, I make a decree, etc. (cf. וְעַתָּה similarly in letters 2 K 5:6, 10:2, and και νῦν 2 Macc. 1:6).

title: II ענה
content:
[Str6031,6035,6041] II. ענה (√ of foll.; v. BH III. ענה, עָנָו, עָנִי).

[Str6033] † [עֲנָי K§ 57 a) β) Str, or עֲנֵה cf. Buhl, M] adj. poor, needy;—pl. abs. עֲָנָ+ין (Bear Gi Kl. c.), or עֲָ+ניִן (van d. H. Buhl M77*; cf. D§ 39, 1) as n. Dn 4:24 the poor.

title: ענז
content:
[Str5795,6049] ענז (√ of following; v. BH ענז, עֵז).

[Str5796] † [עֵז] n.[f.] (she-) goat;—pl. עִזִּין Ezr 6:17.

[Str6050,6051] † [עֲנָן K§ 57 a) α)] n.[m.] cloud (v. BH I. ענן);—pl. cstr. עֲנָנֵי שְׁמַיָּא Dn 7:13.

[Str6056–57] † [עֲנַף] n.[m.] bough (v. BH ענף);—pl. sf. עַנְפ֫וֺהִי Dn 4:9, 4:11, 4:11, 4:18.

[Str6065,6066] † עֲנָשׁ (K§ a) α)) n.[m.] amercing, confiscation (not Targum Syr.; v. BH);—cstr. נִכְסִין ´ע: Ezr 7:26.

[Str3706] עֶנֶת v. כְּעֶנֶת sub I. [עֲנָה]. above

title: עפא
content:
[Str6073] עפא (√ of foll.; Targum עֲפָא Pa., Syr. ܥܦܐ Pa., enwrap, עֳפִי foliage, ܥܘܦܝܐ flower, etc., BH עפאים, עֳפָיִם as loan-word; cf. perh. As. upû, cloud (-mass)).

[Str6074] † [עֳפִי] n.m.:Dn 4:9 leafage, foliage;—sf. עָפְיֵהּ Dn 4:9, 4:11, 4:18.

title: עֲצַב
content: [Str6088,6087] † [עֲצַב] vb. pain, grieve (Targum (rare); v. BH I. עצב);—Pe. Pt. pass., as adj.: בְּקָל עֲצִיב Dn 6:21 a pained voice (cf. Targum Est 4:1, TargumJ Ex 12:31).

title: עִקַּר
content:
[Str6136,6132] † עִקַּר ( < רָ֯ K§ 59 c)) n.[m.] root, stock (√ עקר, v. BH, and, on meaning of √, SchwallyZMG lii (1898), 140);—cstr. שָׁרְשׁ֫וֺהִי ´ע: Dn 4:12, 4:20, 4:23.

[Str6132] † [עֲקַר] vb. denom Hithpe. be rooted up;—Pf. 3 pl. (m. ? v. K§ 23, 2) אִתְעֲקַ֫רוּ Kt, fpl. רָה- Qr, Dn 7:8.

[Str6146] [עָר], עריך v. ערר

title: עֲרַב
content:
[Str6151] † [עֲרַב] vb. mix (Targum (oft.); Syr. (rare); v. BH I. ערב);—Pa. Pt. pass. מְעָרַב mixed with (ב) Dn 2:41, 2:43. Hithpa. Pt. id.: מִתְעָרַב v:43 (עִם), pl. רֲבִין- v:43 (ב).

[Str6167,6171] † [עֲרָד K§ 57 a) α)] n.m. wild ass (Targum Syr.; √עֲרד, perh. = Ar. غرد give a cry NöSBWAk. cxlii. v. II. 1900, v. BH עָרוֺד as loan-word (KAramaismen 72, but dub. NöZMG lvii (1903), 413));—pl. emph. עֲרָדַיָּא Dn 5:21.

[Str6168,6173,6173] ‡ † [עַרְוָה] n.f. dishonour (√ערה, BH be naked (q.v.), עֶתְוָה nakedness);—cstr. עַרְוַת Ezr 4:14.

title: ערר
content:
[Str6862] ערר (√of foll., cf. BH II. צָרַר, III. צַר).

title: עֲשַר
content:
[Str6236,6235] † עֲשַר, עַשְרָה n.m. et f. a ten (v. BH);—m. (foll. n.f.) Dn 7:7, 7:20, 7:24; f. (before n.m.) v:24; תְּרֵי עֲשַר = twelve (foll. n.m.) 4:26, Ezr 6:17.

[Str6243] † עֶשְרִין n.pl. indecl. twenty;—´מְאָה וְע: Dn 6:2 (follows n.m.).

[Str6246,6245] † [עֲשִׁת], עֲשִׁית (K§§ 38, 1 a); 17, 2. Anm. 2) vb. think, plan (BH II. עשׁת (q.v.) as Aramaism; Targum אִתְעַשֵּׁת, not Syr.);—Pf. 3 ms. (strictly Pt. pass. NöGGA 1884, 1019; Syr. Gr. § 280 M78*) ´ע: Dn 6:4, sq. inf., plan to so and so.

[Str3706] עֶת v. כְּעֶת. p. 1107

[Str6267–68,6275] † עַתִּיק adj. advanced, aged (BH (as Aramaism), √עתק, q.v.);—cstr. (מַיָּא-) יוֺמִין ´ע: one advanced, aged, in days Dn 7:9, 7:13, 7:22 (cf. Syr. ܥܬܝܩ ܝܘܡܬܐ Ecclus 25:4 al., PS3011).

[Str6347,6346] † פֶּחָה n.m. (Bab. or Pers.) governor (As. loan-word, BH id.);—abs. ´פ: Ezr 5:14; cstr. פַּחַת Ezr 5:3, 5:6, 6:6, 6:7, 6:13; pl. emph. פַּחֲוָתָא Dn 3:2, 3:3, 3:27, 6:1.

[Str6353] † פֶּצָר n.m. potter ( = paḫḫâr, Targum פַּצָר (also clay), Syr. ܦܚܪܐ; prob. loan-word fr. As. paḫaru, potter, cf. Brock ZimBuhl);—abs. ´פ: Dn 2:41.

M78* al. ´פַּטִּי:), פַּטְּשֵׁיהוֺן Qr, Dn 3:21; conj. on meaning v. in Behrm Bev Dr M78*.
